w: In the evening Swamishri travelled to Raas village and performed pujan of Thakorji at the Swaminarayan mandir. After performing arti, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
The guru dispenses the anaesthesia of atma and Paramatma's knowledge. This makes one insensitive to the duals of praise and insult, happiness and misery.
We have progressed tremendously but we have also become equally miserable. The reason is we are not practising our morals and culture.
It is a fashion for many to say that they do not believe in God. But how can you forget Him who has given you this human birth and blessed you with so many favors!
A person is beautiful by the measure of his virtues and not by the nice clothes he wears.
A friend is not a friend when he shows you to do things that damage your body, house and money.

Rath Yatra Festival In the evening assembly, Pujya Balmukund Swami and Pujya Viveksagar Swami explained the significance of the Rath Yatra festival. When Swamishri arrived, he was welcomed by children with a festive dance. Then Swamishri performed the arti of Thakorji and thereafter, with a remote control panel, guided the chariot with Thakorji. The singing of the bhajan, "Kunvar rangile Kan bethe rath..." and the darshan of Rath Yatra charged the assembly with devotion and joy. The festival was capped with Swamishri's blessings, "The Rath Yatra festival in Jagannathpuri is attended by hundreds of thousands of devout people. It is because of religious feelings in people that such festivals are celebrated with excitement and joy… By celebrating festivals one's devotion for God is enhanced, faith in Him is consolidated and morals are strengthened."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj Arrives in Toronto After concluding a series of conventions for children, teenagers and youths, Swamishri arrived in Toronto. Swamishri was received by kishores dancing enthusiastically, after which he formally opened the Swaminarayan Haveli in accordance with Vedic rituals. During the evening welcome assembly, kishores performed a lively welcome dance. Thereafter, distinguished guests welcomed Swamishri. Acharya Kishoreji Vyas from the Kanchi Koti Pitham, founded by Adi Shankracharya, was present in the assembly and he spoke about Swamishri's efforts to preserve Hindu culture and values. Finally, Swamishri, in his blessings, emphasised the rarity of acquiring a human body, which must be utilised in the worship of God. He also spoke about preserving traditional culture and values, and mentioned that children are the real wealth which must be nurtured. This can all be accomplished through the grace of God and His holy Sadhu.

After concluding a series of conventions for children and youths in Orlando, Florida, Swamishri arrived in Toronto to begin celebrations for the formal opening of the Shri Swaminarayan Haveli. Swamishri was received by kishores dancing enthusiastically, after which he formally opened the Swaminarayan Haveli in accordance with Vedic rituals.

During the Swagat evening assembly, begun traditionally by the singing of dhoon and prarthana, senior saints enlightened devotees. P. Viveksagar Swami spoke about the sanstha's various humanitarian activities while P. Doctor Swami explained the importance of doing Satsang.

After Swamishri arrived, kishores performed a lively Swagat dance, "Anandno Avsariyo." Thereafter, distinguished guests welcomed Swamishri. Acharya Kishoreji Vyas from the Kanchi Koti Pitham founded by Adi Shankracharya was present in the assembly, and he spoke about Swamishri's efforts to preserve Hindu culture and values.

Finally, Swamishri, in his blessings, emphasized the rarity of acquiring a human body, which must be utilized in the worship of God. He also spoke about preserving sanskruti, and mentioned that children are the real wealth which must be nurtured. This can all be accomplished through the grace of God and His Saint.
Tuesday, 12 July 2005 (Ashadh sud 6, Samvat 2061), Delhi

Seated in the car, Pramukh Swami Maharaj came to his residence. During breakfast, Atmakirti Swami introduced the staff connected with the stone work of Akshardham. Sureshbhai Dave, of the Sompura community, originally from Patan, was here doing the seva of carving the elephants of Akshardham. Seeing his skill, another company repeatedly sent him offers: "If you come to work for us, we will give you two lakh rupees and send you abroad." For two to four months these tempting offers kept coming to him, but he had a firm resolve in his mind that the seva of such a grand and divine Akshardham does not come again and again, and so he told them, "Never mind two lakh, even if you give me ten lakh rupees, I will not leave this seva."

For the success of Swamishri’s Satsang tour members of 57 women’s centres in USA had performed continuous chanting of Swaminarayan dhun in which 3,060 balikas, kishoris, yuvatis and mahilas had participated. The dhun times were allotted according to the zonal time differences.

Prior to Swamishri’s morning puja the maha-puja rituals for the foundation-stone laying ( shilanyas ) ceremony of the first phase for the Akshardham complex project in New Jersey commenced in the presence of senior sadhus. After the morning puja Swamishri performed pujan of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and then did pujan of the five nidhi-kumbhs (to be placed in the foundation pits brought by senior sadhus. All the kumbhs were placed near Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Swamishri performed arti. Prayers were offered and dhun chanted for the successful completion of the project. Finally, Swamishri performed pujan of the main shila and sanctified it with flowers and rice grains.

Today Pramukh Swami Maharaj performed the Vedic shila pujan (stone worship) rites for laying the foundation stones of the grand, artistic shikharbaddh mandir and the associated assembly hall and other buildings to be built in the Swaminarayan Akshardham complex in Robbinsville, New Jersey. After completing this foundation stone ceremony for the Hindu mandir and prayer hall according to the Indian architectural tradition, Swamishri worshipped each stone. Devotees who had come from America were sitting in front. The hall was also filled with other devotees.
Harshadbhai Chavda was standing below in the assembly hall itself. Swamishri's eyes fell on him and he immediately called Ishwarcharan Swami and said, "Introduce Harshad."

On Swamishri's instruction, the announcer, Aksharvatsal Swami, described Harshadbhai Chavda's contribution. Harshadbhai Chavda had been responsible for the carving of all the stones of Akshardham in Delhi. In the same way, he was to look after the carving and shipping of the stones for the Akshardham and mandir in New Jersey. Swamishri called him close and showered flower petals on him, showing his pleasure. Swamishri never forgets anyone's seva.
Vedmangal Swami, who had come from Jaipur, said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Bapa! Why do you take pills?"
Swamishri said, "I have to take them, don't I! These are the ways of the body."
He said, "A year ago, right here, you blessed me and I no longer had to take pills. My illness was also cured."
Swamishri said laughingly, "Sometimes when you all fall ill and have to take pills, you will all have the strength of knowing that Swami too takes pills. That is why we take pills."

Vedmangal Swami, who had come from Jaipur, said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Bapa! Why do you take tablets?"

Smiling, Swamishri said, "So that sometime, when you fall ill and have to take tablets, all of you have the strength of knowing that Swami also takes tablets; that is why we take tablets."

ds.t: Running on the strength of the atma
w: Today a specialist doctor had come to give Mahant Swami Maharaj a medical check up.
After examining Swamishri, he suggested a medicine and said, "By taking this medicine, he will be happy."
Swamishri said, "We are always happy."
Then he said, "I said it because you asked. Otherwise it just carries on... the pain has been going on since Kolkata."
Swamishri had left Kolkata on 29 April. That means he has been bearing the pain for at least the last 75 days.
Atmaswarupdas Swami asked, "What if he does not take this medicine?"
The doctor said, "Then there is a chance of a lot of pain."
Swamishri said, "It runs on the strength of the atma."
The doctor said, "You are very strong. Otherwise it is very hard to bear such pain. As the pain increases, I have even seen people cry."
Pain at which people burst into tears, Swamishri does not even let anyone know about. This is his steadfastness in the atma.

This evening, during his walk, Mahant Swami Maharaj began listening to the book Yogi Vani. In it came Yogiji Maharaj's definition of an excuse: "What is an excuse? 'Today someone is ill at home; today guests have come; I cannot come today': that is called an excuse."
Making this definition clearer, Swamishri said, "It may even be true. But if it is something that could be set aside so that one could come, and one does not come, it counts as an excuse."

Next came: "Maharaj always dwells in the eternal Gunatit. He is present now and will remain in the future too. His line does not end. A devotee who has such unshakeable conviction deserves 11 titles."
Swamishri said, "What kind of conviction? That the Gunatit is here today and will be in the future too."
In this way, Swamishri is giving us the very essence of the essence.

Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the assembly of the "Regional Management Meeting" (RMM) being held in the haveli. At the end of the assembly, Swamishri gave all the volunteers the chance to touch his feet individually. Then Swamishri said, "I still have to put my hand on the heads of the first five or six devotees. Call them."

Everyone was moved... How much care Swamishri takes of us! And the amazing thing was that exactly five or six people had been left out. Putting his hand on their heads, Swamishri went out, folding his hands to everyone.
How could one who does not miss even putting his hand on our heads ever miss taking us to Akshardham?
